examples.english: Hotels change the sheets every day.

notes:
シーツ (from English "sheets") refers to bed linens that cover the mattress. In Japanese, the singular form is used even when referring to a set.

Related bedding terms:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧カバー (futon cover)
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧カバー (pillowcase)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}→掛け布団：07014_kakebuton⟧ (comforter/duvet)
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧ (blanket)

Common expressions:
- シーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧ (spread sheets)
- シーツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (change sheets)
- ⟦ボックスシーツ→ボックスシーツ：noentry⟧ (fitted sheet)
